name: PLC & Controller Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of programmable logic controllers, RTUs, and DCS controllers. Covers unauthorized logic modification detection, firmware integrity verification, programming port exposure, default credential auditing, and controller access control evaluation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to PLC or controller security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands PLC/RTU/DCS function and why controller security matters for operational safety
evidence: Can explain what PLCs, RTUs, and DCS controllers do in an industrial process
Aware of common controller attack vectors: logic modification, firmware tampering, programming port access
Understands why controller assessment requires extreme caution and safety coordination

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can perform basic controller security checks in lab environments under supervision
evidence: Identifies controller models, firmware versions, and exposed interfaces
Tests for default credentials and unauthenticated programming access
Reviews controller access control configuration with guidance
Documents findings with awareness of operational safety constraints

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses controller security with appropriate safety controls
evidence: Evaluates controller authentication, authorization, and firmware integrity
Assesses logic protection mechanisms and unauthorized modification risks
Tests programming protocol security without disrupting operational processes
Produces controller security assessment reports with safety-aware recommendations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses diverse controller platforms; develops safe assessment methodology; mentors others
evidence: Assesses controllers across multiple vendors and industrial protocols
Develops safe, repeatable assessment procedures for production environments
Reviews ladder logic and structured text for security-relevant conditions
Mentors junior staff on safe controller assessment practices

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's controller security assessment practice; publishes research
evidence: Established the lab's PLC and controller security assessment methodology
Published research on controller vulnerabilities or assessment techniques
Deep expertise across multiple PLC/DCS platforms
Trains teams on controller security assessment and safe testing

assessment_methods.description: Assess a lab PLC environment: enumerate controllers, test authentication, evaluate logic protection, and verify firmware integrity without disrupting simulated processes
Review controller security assessment reports for technical depth, safety compliance, and actionable findings

equipment: ICS/SCADA lab environment with representative PLCs and HMIs
